units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 1:6">Gen. R. s. 1</cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 36:1">Lev. R. s. 36</cite> <he>לב׳ שמים וכ׳</he> as to creation (plan), the heavens were the first; as to finishing (execution) &c.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 7">Gen. R. s. 7</cite>, end <he>בְּרִיָּיתוֹ של עולם</he> the creation of the world.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 17">Gen. R. s. 17</cite> man looks <he>למקום ברייתו</he> to where he was created from (the earth), woman … <he>למקום בְּרִיָּיתָהּ</he> to where she was made from (the rib); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 6:7">Mikv. VI, 7</cite> <he>כל שהוא מבְּרִיַּית המיים</he> whatever originates in the water (aquatic plants or animals).—
<cite ref="Makkot 17a">Macc. 17ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>חיטה אחת כברייתה</he> one wheat grain in its natural condition, <he>נמלה כברייתה</he> an ant in its natural condition (though small).
<cite ref="Makkot 17a:6">Ib.</cite> <he>בריית נשמה</he> the natural condition of an animated being.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 3:7">Nidd. III, 7</cite> <he>בריית הזכר</he> the formation of a male embryo.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 94b:4">B. Kam. 94ᵇ</cite> <he>חוזר לברייתו</he> is changed into its original condition.
